QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_47

question.text: Under SAS-500, if the SE's environmental-programme area overlaps with a state-funded MGNREGA watershed, attribution becomes complex. The DEFENSIBLE approach is:

answer.text: Disclose the convergence assumptions, limitations, and contribution basis explicitly in the Report — avoid overclaiming contribution and acknowledge deadweight
Combine into a single number without disclosure

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports convergence with government partnerships, avoiding overclaiming through contribution/deadweight assumptions, and disclosing calculations and assumptions used to derive impact figures. The Trap: Option B overclaims. Option C ignores the confounder. Option D hides the assumption — all violate SAS-500 transparency. Note: Disclose the basis of any convergence allocation so users of the Report can evaluate the contribution. The source does not prescribe a specific expenditure/activity/time formula.
